scope: Deterministic reconstruction of the declared source-prefix statistic on every supplied mouse/context. No figures, historical nulls, cohort inference or improvement assessment.
case_order: exact cases.json list order; retain every case including explicit ineligible/undefined outcomes
input_schema: schema_reader.py documents the five observation arrays. Full raw trace/timestamp vectors remain supplied; the declared policy determines support, with no padding or cell removal.
event_identity: Select the case event_column from the context CSV after stripping header whitespace; physical 1-based CSV row includes header as row 1. Preserve every finite nonblank row before rounding/dedup. Identity is sha256:<exact CSV SHA256>|column:<stripped column name>|csv-row:<physical row>. Never truncate Unicode tokens. Nonblank nonnumeric/nonfinite fields fail as operator input errors.

report_schema.rho: finite float in [-1,1] only for computed; null for every other status; no NaN/Infinity literals or duplicate JSON keys

array_schema.encoding: ZIP_STORED NPZ; exact members only, NPYv1/v2, no pickle/object arrays. Numeric values float64 except int64 peak indices/orders; IDs full Unicode. All arrays at most 2D. Extra/missing/duplicate arrays reject.
array_schema.geometry: ETA cell×420; zscore cell×280; peak/order/vector arrays cell-length; base arrays preserve full exact selected identities/times. Insufficient support/events have only base arrays. Undefined normalization includes response stage; computed/undefined correlation include peak tail. Numerical-review cases are retained for review with no automatic numerical pass.

hash_contract.policy: SHA256 of exact approved_policy as JSON sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),allow_nan=False, UTF-8.
hash_contract.input: SHA256 beginning with JSON of case_id/animal_id/context (sorted compact UTF-8). Then traces,timestamps,cell_ids,events,event_ids in that order: 8-byte big-endian descriptor length, compact JSON [key,dtype.str,list(shape)], 8-byte big-endian C-order byte length, and exact C-order bytes. This is a binding token, not proof of calculation.

numerical_checks.guards: Unchanged qualified verifier-v3. Rank/near-peak/near-flat discontinuities require interpretation review; never relax tolerance to force pass.

capacity.diagnostics_policy: Optional flat regular files are inventoried and counted but never copied/graded. No directories, links, sockets or devices.

warning: This explicitly supplied recipe is for replay infrastructure qualification. It is not a paper-only interpretation/reasoning experiment.
submission_interface: One finished42filedirectory; the scoring adapter never executes candidate Python.
